apiKey.description: `token <api key>:<api secret>`. The caller's own capabilities apply.
apiKey.name: Authorization

info.description: Central is the control plane for Frappe Cloud v2. It owns identity, teams, servers, sites and billing. Send the header `Authorization: token <api key>:<api secret>`. The capabilities of the token's user decide access. AI agents read `/assets/central/agents.md` first.

get.description:

caller's own role, how many people are in it, when it was created, and the
onboarding steps the caller still has to answer as its owner. A suspended team is listed with
its `status`, so the console can say why it cannot open it.

with `is_impersonated` set.
